acceptance: Fixed synthetic no-dispatch IntentFile calibration can produce scoped opaque binary readback; declaration and fixture proof never enable file runtime capability.

implementation.canary: One immutable data/filename/type sample; both core and generated-host plan decoders reject caller changes. It is a calibration payload, never an AutomationCase.
implementation.host: SDK setter then IntentFile getter; exact data and metadata comparison; no perform/run dispatch. Separate binary XCTAttachment and descriptor-only receipt JSON.
implementation.import: Retained strict export schema, pinned test identifier, exact attachment inventory, private bounded reads, sample hash/count/metadata and full scoped receipt validation before native artifact persistence.
implementation.privacy: Only opaque references escape. Binary and file-bearing runner logs occupy native-only reserved paths; ordinary artifact resolution denies access. Ownership drain and exact payload sanitation precede publication.

verification.reviews: Two distinct Sol read-only reviews found no material defects: immutable input/binary privacy and host/manifest/resource lifecycle.

limitations: Synthetic command fixtures mint no live-context authority or codec availability. Actual SDK setter/readback, xcresult test/attachment naming and child closure still require admitted runtime qualification. apple.codec.intentFile remains unavailable. No runtime launch, push, publication or full M0-M6 completion.
